First, I am assuming that you post on Voat under some other name, and created HelpMePlease specifically for this purpose, so as not to tie your past research to your present problem.

  1. If the agency really is called DCS (Department of Child Services), then I think you're likely living in one of just a few states. (I won't post their names here, no point making things easy for trolls.) State by state, the names vary enormously and few are called DCS. Washington DC is not one, neither is Virginia.

  2. If local authorities are coming after you, then you've likely done something that poses a threat to them in that locality. It seems less likely to me that (for example) you turned up something about the Pegasus Museum and that James Alefantis has the sort of pull to get a distant state DCS after you.

  3. This leads to my first question: How did they figure out it was you? Do you know, or have any theories? This is key to fighting back. The most alarming scenario would be that someone in your state's pedo network who wanted you stopped could read whatever you posted here, and trace your IP from Voat. That would mean that everyone on Voat is vulnerable to similar doxxing and harassment. But that's unlikely for a number of reasons. (For one thing, we'd have seen doxxing and harassment much sooner and aimed at many more people.)

  4. It sounds like whatever it is that you found, it's not conclusive yet. You don't have enough to get someone thrown into jail, but you MIGHT have enough if you keep going. If it really was conclusive, they wouldn't be wasting time with the dead animals, or going through your trash. I don't mean to be morbid; this is actually a good thing, because what really destroys these guys is usually the attempt at a cover-up. So my first piece of advice is: Build up your paper trail like crazy. Get lawyers to write letters on your behalf. Get documents notarized. As other people urged, make sure there are copies of all videos or emails or phone calls. And make sure THEY know that you're doing that. Make them understand that you won't be an easy target, that it will cost them time, money, and exposure to come after you. Whatever you think started this, get it on the record as well.
